items.title: Require a recorded dev-memory preflight acknowledgement before a story may enter DEV
items.context: Mirrors the existing scope_boundary_set/execution_boundary_set/scope_freeze_check INIT_CHECK-gating pattern. New command (e.g. dev_memory_preflight_ack) writes a JSON artifact under .lattice/story/actives/<id>/ recording that dev_memory_preflight was run and its topHitIds were seen; the DEV-entry gate refuses to advance without this artifact present and bound to the current story's material.

items.title: Append a non-blocking dev-memory capture reminder to finding_resolve output
items.context: After finding_resolve completes, append advisory text (does not block, does not mutate anything else) prompting the caller to consider dev_memory_capture for the finding's root cause/fix if it represents a genuinely reusable lesson.

items.title: Require a recorded dev_memory_finish_decision before a story may reach DONE
items.context: Add to canFinishGuard (core/machine.ts) or wherever the DONE checklist is assembled: require a dev_memory_finish_decision record for the story, accepting captured | no-reusable-lesson | defer-with-reason as satisfying answers. Mirrors how summary_set/delivery-check are already required DONE items.
